PR title = the commit message on main. Use Conventional Commits:
  feat: add …   fix: handle …   docs: explain …   chore: update …
Add "!" after the type for breaking changes, e.g. "feat!: …".
-->

## What

<!-- What does this change do? One or two sentences. -->

## Why

<!-- The problem or request behind it. Link the issue: "Closes #12". -->

## How it was tested

<!-- Commands run, environments used, what you checked. "Not tested" is an answer — say why. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit line
- [ ] README / docs updated if behavior, setup, or deployment changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (repositories that publish releases)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, customer data, or build output in the diff
- [ ] Automated review findings addressed (if enabled)
